ModuleTitle.helper: Used by OpenContent and DNN module settings. This is not displayed to site visitors.

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Used to create #anchor-links on the page. Use only letters, numbers, and hyphens.

VideoSourceType.helper: Choose Auto Detect unless you need to force the template to treat the URL as a regular video file or as YouTube.

VideoUrl.helper: Required. This is the desktop source video. For best results, use an HD video sized around 1920 × 1080. Local paths, external video file URLs, and YouTube URLs are supported. Examples: /Portals/0/Videos/homepage-hero-desktop.mp4, https://cdn.example.com/video-desktop.mp4, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=abc123

MobileTabletVideoUrl.helper: Optional. Use this for a mobile and tablet-friendly source video. For best results, use an HD video sized around 1280 × 720. If this is left empty, the desktop video will be used on all screen sizes.
